device_entry.name: 罗德与施瓦茨 SHM52 信号发生器
device_entry.description: 一款射频信号发生器，频率范围约为 100 kHz 至 2 GHz。可用于实验与电子测试中的信号输出，支持设置频率、幅度以及输出开关。
device_entry.description_en: An RF signal generator with an approximate frequency range of 100 kHz to 2 GHz. It is used for signal output in laboratory and electronic test setups, with support for frequency setting, amplitude setting, and output enable control.
